facts.business: Asgard Alcobev Limited is a BSE-listed beverages company that operates one of the largest brewing platforms in Northeast India through its subsidiary CMJ Breweries Private Limited, producing beer under contract for major brands and its own portfolio of seven labels.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: installed capacity of 700,000 hectolitres a year

key_risks: changes in state excise policy, licensing and pricing regimes across the states in which the Company's products are sold
the renewal, variation or termination of contract manufacturing and franchise arrangements
the availability and cost of malt, hops, glass, aluminium, energy and freight
interruption at the Company's single manufacturing facility
changes in interest rates and the availability of finance
the successful integration of the recently acquired subsidiary
